scope: Review draft for the 7f/26f candidate comparison only. This is not evidence for the later main 509 vision delta.

initial_existing_paths_screen.method: One retained ABBA round, two samples per arm per cell; existing cmd_bench_model with one untimed prefill and decode followed by one measured repeat per phase. No retries or sample removal.

activity.limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed. New, disappeared, or inaccessible processes make attribution incomplete; unrelated CPU is a lower-bound estimate. Missing GPU counters are not treated as zero.

cpu_q8_repeat.method: Six retained ABBA blocks for CPU Q8_0 PP128/TG128; no retries, filtering, or automatic performance gate.

activity.limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are coverage limits. The saved summary does not establish process attribution as a complete census.

cpu_q8_repeat.cgroup: Per-call memory.events and cpu.stat deltas were retained; the run records cgroup telemetry complete.

selected_functions.name: row_dot
selected_functions.difference: One vandps RIP-relative target label/address differs; root-observed objdump dumps for both binaries show identical 16-byte target contents ffffff7f000000000000000000000000.

static_codegen_review.interpretation: No source-level Q8 loop addition or changed control flow was identified in these inspected symbols. This is not whole-binary equivalence and does not attribute the timing result.

disposition: The initial -10.904% CPU TG signal was not reproduced at similar magnitude: the six-block repeat is -1.586% overall with mixed block signs amid persistent activity flags. Treat CPU TG impact as uncertain, report the complete tradeoff, and retain it for review; these data establish neither a regression nor equivalence and do not justify an automatic green or a new cutoff. The initial MI50 deltas range from -0.478% to +0.818% in this bounded screen.

root_disposition.decision: Keep all measurements and close additional CPU repeats for this tested pair. Accept the observed complete tradeoff as existing-path timing evidence, with CPU TG uncertainty explicitly retained; this is not a no-regression claim or a full landing pass.
basis: Six additional fixed ABBA blocks were completed with all samples retained; TG effect changes sign across blocks.
The repeated aggregate PP gain is5.267% against TG loss1.586%; the original10.904% TG loss remains reported.

root_disposition.remaining: Own8B file qualification, applicable new-main delta/build audit and final landing gates remain separate; this decision changes no correctness limits.
